page.layout: One printed page (left page, p. 212): running head at top, one text column of full width; below the last line the catchword "tur," at the right. No marginal notes. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: quandam & hesperum præ cæteris fulgere decet, quem subditi tanquam patriæ patrem, pacis publicæ defensorem, parentem publicum, bono reip.natum, tutorem status publici,colant & venerentur.Ad quæ omnia ingenii culturâ excellenti,per literas sacras & profanas opus est,utque ad eas animi & corporis dotes, quæ in futuro principe requiruntur, liberali quâdam disciplinâ, puer adhuc & adolescens, formetur. Si enim legis divinæ liber omnibus vitæ suæ diebus apud regem esse, & omnia illius verba custodire, atque facere ille debet, necessarium est ut à teneris unguiculis legi & verbo Dei operam det. Cicero sanè ad Quintum fratrem: Princeps,inquit,ille in-genii & doctrinæ Plato,tum demum fore beatas respublicas putavit,si aut docti & sapientes homines eas regere coepissent, aut qui regerent, omne suum studium in doctrinâ & sapientiâ collocassent. Recte etiam Vegetius:Nullus, inquit, est, quem oporteat vel plura scire, quam principem, cujus doctrina debet omnib. prodesse subjectis.Neq; etiam aliâ ratione principem bonū, omnis generis virtutibus heroicis verè illustrifsimum, usu & cognitione rerum necessariarum præditum, habebunt aliquando subditi, quàm rectæ educationis beneficio. Nulla vicissim perniciosior principû, & totius reip.pestis est, quàm si in mediâ adulatorum & parasitorum aulicorum turbâ, inter canum venaticorum latratus, equorum hinnitus, militum strepitus, & aularum delicias atque mollitiem illi adolescant, si ad ipsorum placitû & libitum, circa ipsos omnia personent, & auribus ipsorum crebrò insufurre-

page.notes: Running head "Uter" at top right is read as printed and kept with "LIBRI III."; the catchword "tur," is set right below the last line. Italic boundaries inside the Cicero and Vegetius quotations are approximate: the italic and roman switches are hard to separate at this scan resolution. The "s" forms are long s in the print and have been written as plain s. Nothing on this page was illegible.
